subject: NorthStar Summit — pipeline credit split & lead triage
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@northstar.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Jared Li <jared.li@northstar.io>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NorthStar Summit — post-show lead list and credit question

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for partnering with NorthStar on the sponsor stage last week. Attached is the lead export from our onsite badge scan + session opt-ins. We flagged ~240 records that expressed explicit interest in a demo or pricing follow-up.

Per our contract we expected a 50/50 attribution split for co-marketed demo leads, but your team is reporting a different set of MQLs tied to demo requests that we believe originated from our session. Can you help reconcile?

Quick ask: can your team confirm which of the attached leads were converted to HubSpot contacts and share the HubSpot IDs so we can cross-reference? Jared and I are looping in events ops so we can close out billing and sponsor wrap.

Attachments:
- NorthStar_Lead_List_Q3.csv (badge+session opt-ins)

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Partnerships & Events
NorthStar Events

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@northstar.io>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthStar Summit — post-show lead list and credit question

Ellen — thanks for the list and the note. We pulled the records on our side and see 78 leads that progressed to a demo request in HubSpot between Aug 5–12. I dropped a quick mapping export into the shared Drive link (see related_links) but we should align on attribution logic before we lock invoices.

Proposal from Redwood:
- We map credit based on the earliest traceable touch for each HubSpot contact (session opt-in, webinar registration, ad click, or Redwood-initiated outreach).
- For leads where NorthStar session opt-in is the first touch, you receive primary credit. For others we split credit with a heavier weight to the originator.

Immediate asks for reconciliation:
1) Can you confirm which of the CSV rows are considered "session opt-in" vs general badge scan? Your export has both.
2) Send any HubSpot IDs you have for your follow-up so Ben can reconcile duplicates.

If we need a faster resolution, I'm open to an interim credit split we can lock now and revisit after full CRM tieout. Happy to jump on a quick call tomorrow.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@northstar.io>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthStar Summit — post-show lead list and credit question

Thanks for looping me in Rishi. A couple of considerations from revenue/marketing ops before we finalize numbers:

- Lead velocity matters: a lead that became MQL within 48 hours of the session should be weighted more to the session owner.
- Demo conversions coming from our SDR outreach after the show are still influenced by the sponsor placement but should be credited differently than an explicit session opt-in.

Suggested interim split (for invoicing and sponsor payout):
- Session opt-ins with documented session attendance: 65% NorthStar / 35% Redwood
- Badge scans & generic booth traffic that later converted via Redwood outreach: 40% NorthStar / 60% Redwood

Ben — can you take Ellen's CSV and our HubSpot export and produce a deduped mapping with columns: NorthStar_row_id, hubspot_contact_id, first_touch_type, first_touch_timestamp, conversion_status? If you can get that by EOD Friday (Aug 15) we'll lock the interim payouts and then reconcile in 30 days.

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@northstar.io>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthStar Summit — post-show lead list and credit question

On Fri, Aug 14, 2026 at 11:02 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ellen — thanks for the list and the note. We pulled the records on our side and see 78 leads that progressed to a demo request in HubSpot between Aug 5–12.

Thanks — working through the CSV now. Quick notes on process:
- I'll run fuzzy email matching and phone normalization to dedupe.
- For rows without emails, I'll use badge_id + timestamp to attempt a match against our event form submissions.
- I'll add a confidence score column so we can be explicit about ties that are low-confidence.

Attached output (preview) and MAP draft: NS-Summit-MutualActionPlan-v1.xlsx.

Prelim findings (sample):
- 78 demo-converted contacts; 42 have session opt-in as first touch; 22 look like booth/badge-only and later converted after SDR outreach; 14 are ambiguous (low confidence).

Next steps:
1) Ellen/Jared — can you provide HubSpot contact IDs for the 14 ambiguous rows (if you have them) or confirm they are booth-only?
2) If no IDs, we'll apply the interim split Marissa proposed and mark as "final pending CRM tieout".

I'll push the deduped file into the shared Drive and flag the low-confidence rows.

-ben
Ben Carter
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced:
- NS-Summit-MutualActionPlan-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan + mapping preview)

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@northstar.io>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthStar Summit — post-show lead list and credit question

Appreciate the fast turnaround team — thanks Ben for the draft. Jared and I reviewed and pulled HubSpot IDs for 9 of the 14 ambiguous rows and uploaded an updated CSV to the shared Drive. We agree to Marissa's interim splits to close invoices:

- Session opt-ins (documented attendance): 65% NorthStar / 35% Redwood
- Badge-only converts: 40% NorthStar / 60% Redwood

We'd like formal reconciliation in 30 days after a final tieout. Please confirm when you submit the invoice and we will trigger sponsor payout. Also requesting a single-line summary for finance with final counts by bucket so our accounting team can process the sponsor settlement.

Thanks — Ellen
Ellen Park
Partnerships & Events
NorthStar Events
